articles.title: A Fresh Definition of the Product Role
articles.summary: AI makes building easier, but product judgment remains scarce. Strong product managers identify the right problems, discover valuable solutions, and ensure they work for the business.

articles.title: Can Agents Use a Computer Yet? We've Got the Data
articles.summary: Computer-using agents are reaching production, but the real moat is no longer model capability. It is the context, infrastructure, and reliability needed to automate real business workflows at scale.

articles.title: A Good Move is Grounded
articles.summary: Effective product work connects internal changes directly to external user activity. Validate initiatives like MVPs against specific hypotheses and behavioral goals. If a clear link is missing, use small probes or targeted adjustments to bridge the gap.

articles.title: 20 Unfiltered Operating Takes
articles.summary: Great product teams win through strong habits, small iterations, and continuous learning, not rigid frameworks. AI will amplify whatever operating system a team already has, good or bad.

articles.title: Build an AI code review bot in 30 minutes + Claude Code for normal people (24 minute video)
articles.summary: AI can handle routine code reviews when teams define clear risk thresholds, preserve human oversight for higher-risk changes, and continuously evaluate the agent's decisions. New agent platforms also make these systems surprisingly easy to build, putting more emphasis on good instructions and operational design than infrastructure.

articles.title: From Agile to the Product Operating Model: What Practitioners Say Is Actually Changing
articles.summary: Product Operating Models may improve delivery and collaboration, but they often leave the underlying decision system unchanged. AI, meanwhile, is reshaping product decisions with or without a formal transformation.

articles.title: How Grindr overhauled its back end while ‘terraforming' a future as an AI-native
articles.summary: AI has made engineering dramatically faster at Grindr, shifting the bottleneck toward product judgment and accelerating the convergence of engineering, design, and product roles.

articles.title: I'm a PM Who Built a Travel-Tech Startup Solo — Using AI as My Engineering Team
articles.summary: A product manager built Simsima (a global travel eSIM marketplace) in weeks by leveraging AI as an engineering team.

articles.title: Fifteen Tics
articles.summary: Effective leadership requires managing one's personal 'tics' and habits rather than imposing them as rules.

articles.title: Want taste? Eat your slop
articles.summary: Developers build "taste" by "dogfooding" their own products to identify workflow issues.
